R6J-moose-walk-0003.name: 3.0 km S of Natazutlo Lake
R6J-moose-walk-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R6J-moose-walk-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Kazchek FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: 22 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 16.0 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2020 (6 years old), 120 m NE: browse.
Moose winter range u-7-018 unit 18 (official), 430 m W. Counts from November.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: Omineca South and Central. Closed between 4:30 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. from August 15 to August 31, between 5:30 a.m. and 9:00 a.m. from September 1 to September 30 and between 6:30 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from October 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 7-3/24.

plan: Drive: from Village of Granisle, about 81 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 54.95136, -125.23495, pull off on Kazchek FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 350 m NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 7 m, about 8 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip). Also: black bear (see evidence).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-26, Region 7A. Season: moose spike fork bulls Sept 10 to Nov 5 (synopsis page 57, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
R6J-moose-walk-0003.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 7-26: about 2,110 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.63 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.3 km and about 7 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
